title: Mrs Nea
body: I used this app occasionally for meetings and events i had to attend but this app has been lifesaver since i became pregnant due to numerous check-ups whose dates i cant remember.
author: Borozann_

title: Big widget
body: It would be great to add huge widget to we can see whole month with our task and events on our homescreen. Overall the app is great 💕
author: myllica26

title: Tasks are either 30-mins or all day
body: I would really appreciate it if tasks were as flexible as any other event. I want to be able to set a certain duration for tasks and tick them as done after I finish.
author: tbkvsvt

title: Suggestion
body:
It would be nice if we could separate tasks into different categories within one google account. I believe many would greatly enjoy that feature. 
Please consider this.
Thank you.
Otherwise pretty standard app, simple usage.
author: maraja24

title: Reminders migrated to tasks
body: Please let us have the reminders back inside the calendar schedule, it used to be so useful!
author: FillFar

title: Battery drain
body: The app drains my battery on ios 14.5. It has over 6 hours of background activity without even opening the app during the day
author: Igorns92

title: Wrong holidays!
body: I pick Serbia in setings and marked Ortodox Holidays but in calendar I have some muslim and jewish holidays?!
author: Baquero011

title: Not available in Serbia
body: This app, YouTube and other essential google apps are not available to download in Serbia so we need to take complicated actions to switch to other country AppStore in order to download those apps. Really unprofessional to force your paying subscribers to do this.
author: Dalibor87
